{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Workflow derived from https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2/examples
# Need help debugging build failures? Start at https://github.com/r-lib/actions#where-to-find-help
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

name: pkgdown

jobs:
  pkgdown:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Only restrict concurrency for non-PR jobs
    concurrency:
      group: pkgdown-${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.run_id }}
    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          use-public-rspm: true

      - name: Cache R package dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: /home/runner/.local/lib/R/site-library
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-R-${{ hashFiles('DESCRIPTION') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-R-

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: any::pkgdown, local::.
          needs: website

      - name: Build site
        run: pkgdown::build_site_github_pages(new_process = FALSE, install = FALSE)
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Deploy to GitHub pages 🚀
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4.4.1
        with:
          clean: false
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: docs",
  "rationale": "The workflow fetches R dependencies on every run via setup-r-dependencies with no dependency cache. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) is supported by the literature report (S01, modest VM-time reduction) and measured fork experiments showing benefit from caching dependency downloads before installation. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for the R library, keyed on DESCRIPTION, before setup-r-dependencies avoids re-fetching unchanged packages while preserving every build/test/deploy step and all existing permissions. Other patterns were rejected: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks a measured duration baseline (ci_history is not_a_measured_baseline), and P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the job deploys to GitHub Pages.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
